Immunization B Name Eight Diseases Principle 2: Explain The Meaning of Immunization Principle 2: Therefore, a different vaccine is needed for each disease (p. 20).

Immunization B Name Eight Diseases Principle 3: Explain The Meaning of Immunization Principle 3: Immunizationsalso are available for many other diseases that are uncommonin the United States but common in other parts of the world (p. 20).

Immunization B Name Eight Diseases Principle 4: Explain The Meaning of Immunization Principle 4: Americans typicallyreceive these immunizations when they travel out of the countryor join the armed forces (p. 20).
step_by_step_procedure: Step 1 (Immunization B Name Eight Diseases): Step 1 (Explain The Meaning of Immunization): Immunization is suggested for very young children, withperiodic booster injections as recommended (p. 20).
Step 2 (Immunization B Name Eight Diseases): Step 2 (Explain The Meaning of Immunization): Antibodies arelong-lasting, but the protection they give may decrease with time (p. 20).
Step 3 (Immunization B Name Eight Diseases): Step 3 (Explain The Meaning of Immunization): A second exposure to a pathogen will increase the level ofantibodies a person's body will produce (p. 20).
Step 4 (Immunization B Name Eight Diseases): Step 4 (Explain The Meaning of Immunization): So a second injection, or booster shot, often is given to help strengthen immunity (p. 20).

Step 3 (Municipal Wastewater Treatment Facility): Step 3 (Do ONE of The Following): Manysuspended particles drop out of the liquid portion as thescreened sewage is allowed to settle (p. 44).
Step 4 (Municipal Wastewater Treatment Facility): Step 4 (Do ONE of The Following): Processing or treatment is done by two basic methods: activated sludge and trickling (p. 44).
